Руководитель белорусской команды Артем П: The leader of the Belarusian team, Artem Pivovarchik, noted the uniqueness of the Olympiad: "Each country holds its national olympiads taking into account the specifics of its school curriculum. Our school curriculum is quite broad, covering almost all topics found in the global International Physics Olympiad. For the younger age group, our olympiad is unique because it is essentially the only international olympiad for junior grades."
Соревнование включало два основных тура:: The competition included two main rounds:
Уникальность экспериментального тура зак: The uniqueness of the experimental round was that the tasks were designed so that participants could conduct experiments without special equipment. As noted by the jury chair, head of the Department of General Physics at BSU, Anatolii Slabadzianiuk: "The task describes real experiments, and students must understand them. The main goal is to grasp the essence of the phenomenon under study and process the available results: calculate, plot graphs, propose hypotheses."

Участники решали обширные задания из раз: Participants solved extensive problems from various areas of school physics. Up to five hours were allotted for the tasks, allowing students to demonstrate deep knowledge and analytical skills.
